name_zh: 普通、职业本专科在校学生数
definition_zh: 指在普通高等学校及职业本科/高职（专科）院校注册就读的本、专科在校学生总人数（单位：万人），反映各省高等教育供给规模与青年人才集聚度。
definition_en: Total enrolled undergraduate and junior-college/vocational students across regular and vocational higher education institutions (10,000 students), compiled from Ministry of Education records.
headline_insight_zh: 2024年河南高校本专科在校生达 309.64 万人，居全国首位
headline_insight_en: Henan leads college enrollment with 309.64 10k students (2024)

source.agency_zh: 中华人民共和国国家统计局
source.agency_en: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
source.database_zh: 国家数据 · 分省年度数据与全国年度数据
source.database_en: NBS National Data · Provincial & National Annual Databases
source.table_name_zh: 国家数据 · 分省年度数据 / 教育 / 普通、职业高等学校和普通、职业本专科学生情况
source.table_name_en: NBS National Data (MOE Source) · Regular & Vocational Higher Education Enrollment
source.release_date: 2025年官方发布（含历史普查修订）

caliber_note_zh: 原始统计由教育部汇总后经国家统计局发布，统计口径为普通、职业本专科在校生（不含研究生与成人高等教育/网络本专科在校生）。2021年起统计名称由「普通本专科」规范为「普通、职业本专科」，将职业本科纳入同一统计序列。
caliber_note_en: Compiled by the Ministry of Education and published via NBS. Covers regular and vocational undergraduate/associate students (excluding graduate students and adult/online programs). Since 2021, vocational undergraduate programs are explicitly named alongside regular programs.
transformation_zh: 直接采用国家统计局发布的万人数值，保留2位小数；不做缺失年份补全。
transformation_en: Directly uses official NBS published figures (10,000 students), rounded to 2 decimal places.
revision_note_zh: 31省分省之和与全国总计高度吻合（在小数四舍五入范围内一致），具备可加性。
revision_note_en: The 31-province sum aligns tightly with the national total within rounding tolerance.
limitations_zh: 仅衡量高校所在地的在学人数，不含研究生（硕士/博士）群体；高校集中省份（如湖北、陕西、北京、江苏）在校生显著包含跨省生源。
limitations_en: Excludes postgraduate (Master's/PhD) students and counts students by institution location rather than home province.

statistical_breaks.description_zh: 2019–2021年全国实施高职百万扩招计划，推动多省高校本专科在校生显著增长。
statistical_breaks.description_en: National vocational higher education expansion accelerated enrollment across provinces in 2019–2021.

missingness_summary.reason_zh: 共存在 31 个官方未公布单元格（历史覆盖率 96.2%），主要来自最新年度分省数据尚未完全公布、2013年城乡一体化口径启用前年份，或普查年份未列入抽样调查表。本平台严格保留空值，绝不插值填造。
missingness_summary.reason_en: 31 provincial cells are unreleased in NBS records (96.2% historical coverage), due to pending latest-year releases, survey launches (e.g., 2013), or census years omitted from sample tables. All gaps are preserved transparently without imputation.
